{{E|Transmogrifier}} is a shrine [[Event]] encountered in all [[Acts]].

Shrine events appear less frequently than other events.

== Options ==
{{Frame|Pray}} {{KW|Transform}} {{TS|positive||a card.}}
* Read more on Transform rules [[Transform#Rules|here]].

{{Frame|Leave}} Nothing happens.

== Dialogue ==
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
Before you lies an elaborate shrine to a forgotten spirit.
</div>

{{Frame|Pray}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
As the power of the shrine flows through you, your mind feels altered.
</div></blockquote>

{{Frame|Leave}}
<blockquote><div style="font-style:italic">
You ignore the shrine.
</div></blockquote>
</blockquote>

== Trivia ==
* Internally called <code>Transmorgrifier</code> where it's misspelled with an extra '''r''' before the '''g'''.
